description: Shape of my_portfolio response — account summary, open positions, and working orders.

fields.description: Account-level state. Net liq, margin, P&L, risk limits.
Account name (echo of input).
Base currency of the account (ISO 4217).

Net liquidation value — account equity mark-to-market. Computed as `cashBalance + openPnL + dollarCollateralCost`. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
Sum of per-currency cash balances (account ledger), before open-P&L.

Unrealized P&L across all open positions. Each position marked at the bid (if long) / offer (if short), falling back to last trade / settlement. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
Realized P&L accumulated for the trading session (sum of per-cashBalance realized-PnL columns).
Total day P&L = realizedPnL + openPnL. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
Current total used margin from MarginSnapshot (event-driven, throttled ~1s).
Margin headroom = netLiq − totalUsedMargin. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
Maintenance margin threshold.
Full initial margin (session-unadjusted).
Equity below this triggers auto-liquidation.
Above this level account is in liquidate-only mode.
Current daily loss as a positive number: `max(0, −dayPnL)`. Zero when the day is profitable.
Daily-loss auto-liquidation threshold (sourced from risk_settings.dailyLossAutoLiq).
Remaining loss budget before auto-liquidation = `max(0, limit − current)`.
Highest observed netLiq used as the trail anchor.
Configured trailing amount (distance from max).
Current trailing floor = maxNetLiq − drawdownAmount.
netLiq − currentLevel; negative ⇒ below floor. Delayed marks lag the auto-liq engine, which marks in real time.
One entry per contract with nonzero net position.
Contract symbol (e.g., ESM6).
Signed net position. Positive = long, negative = short.
Volume-weighted average entry price of the net position (Tradovate `Position.netPrice`).
Mark price used for P&L: bid (if long) / offer (if short), falling back to last trade, then settlement.
Unrealized P&L = (markPrice − netPrice) × netPos × valuePerPoint, where markPrice is `positions[].currentPrice`.
Cumulative contracts bought in this session.
Cumulative contracts sold in this session.
VWAP of all buys.
VWAP of all sells.
Initial margin held for this position.
Monetary value of a 1-point move.
Product name (e.g., 'ES').
Exchange code.

Timeliness of this position's `currentPrice` and `openPnL`. 'RealTime' when the account holds an active market data subscription or trial for the exchange; 'Delayed' by 10m when it does not. Positions on different exchanges can carry different values in one response. The field is absent when the account is entitled to no market data for the exchange.
Contract currency.
Resting / pending orders (does not include filled or cancelled).
Order ID. Used as orderId for modify/cancel.
Contract symbol.
Buy or Sell. See describe(topic='action').
Order type. See describe(topic='orderType').
Contract quantity.
Limit price (present for Limit / StopLimit / TrailingStopLimit).
Stop price (present for Stop / StopLimit / Trailing variants).
Duration. See describe(topic='timeInForce').
Lifecycle status. See describe(topic='ordStatus').
Only on trailing orders. True once the FSM has captured its initial peg distance from the first quote.
Trail distance in price units; absent until the peg is armed.
Parent entry-order ID that spawned this leg.
Sibling leg's ID in the same OCO bracket.
Only on entry orders: the TP/SL legs about to spawn on fill.
Leg quantity.
Profit-target offset from entry price (signed, contract-native units).
Stop-loss offset from entry price (signed).
True when this leg is a trailing stop.
